title: Set up Floorbit
intro: A few steps to get going. Each one can be skipped and done later in Settings.
introAccount: Welcome. First, the account you will sign in with: it becomes the admin.
connected: Already connected. Fill in the fields only to change it.
verify: Check the TLS certificate (turn off for a self-signed one)
alreadyDone: Floorbit is set up. Change anything in Settings.
adminOnly: An admin is still setting up Floorbit.

account.text: Floorbit printed a setup code to its log when it started. It proves you run this server.
account.codeHelp: Find it with: docker compose logs floorbit

netbox.title: NetBox
netbox.text: With NetBox, your switches come from there and you only place them on the floor plan. Without it, you add them by hand.

librenms.title: LibreNMS
librenms.text: LibreNMS adds live status, ports, traffic, and which seat is on which port.

switches.title: Switches
switches.netbox: Bring in the switches from NetBox now. It happens on its own later too.
switches.byHand: Without NetBox, add switches on the floor plan: press S and click where one goes.
switches.place: Then drag each switch to where it stands in the hall.

theme.title: Look
theme.name: Event name
theme.nameHelp: Shown in the top bar and on kiosk screens. Optional.
theme.label: Theme

presets.ops: Ops desk: dense, for the network team
presets.kiosk: Kiosk: big and dark, for screens in the hall
presets.classic: Classic: dark with an orange accent

finish.text: That's it. The floor plan is next.
finish.later: Everything here can be changed in Settings.
